items.summary: SAP S/4HANA's Manage Substitution/Validation Rules function does not sufficiently validate input processed by its domain-specific scripting language, letting an authenticated attacker run arbitrary code. Apply SAP's October security notes.

Progress MarkLogic Server before 12.1.0 / 11.3.7 lets a remote attacker with query-execution access invoke an XQuery evaluation function without the required privilege, leading to server-side code execution with elevated permissions. Upgrade to 12.1.0 or 11.3.7.
IBM Maximo AI Service 9.1.0 and 9.2.0 allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper control of code generation. Update to the patched release.

Bricksforge WordPress plugin through 3.1.8.9 has an unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw allowing remote code execution; Patchstack observed automated in-the-wild exploitation starting Oct 7. Update to 3.1.8.10 immediately.

Progress MarkLogic Server before 12.1.0 / 11.3.7 lets a remote attacker with delegated database-administrator privileges run backup or restore operations on forests outside the authorized database scope, risking unauthorized access to security-critical data. Upgrade to 12.1.0 or 11.3.7.
